Through strategic partnerships and technology deployment, it enables faster adoption of innovations that support enterprise priorities and future growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities. Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact: Lead the way Serve with integrity Take care of each other Foster inclusion Collaborate for measurable impact During your tenure as a Consultant - Manager, you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to establish and lead the Group’s Data Centre business, shaping its strategy, developing key customer and technology partnerships, building the team and taking ownership of growth and profitability across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. The Opportunity You will be responsible for: Assessing the Group’s current organisation, resources, capabilities and gaps and defining what is required to establish and grow the Data Centre EPC business. Developing the overall Data Centre EPC strategy and implementation roadmap . Defining the required organisational structure, engineering capabilities, resources, processes, partners and supply chain. Building and leading the team required to execute the strategy. Establishing the EPC delivery methodology across design, engineering, procurement, construction, MEP, integration, testing and commissioning . Supporting opportunity assessment, tendering, technical proposals, costing, value engineering and project risk evaluation. Developing strong relationships with OEMs, consultants, subcontractors, technology partners and other key stakeholders . Leading the implementation of the Data Centre EPC strategy and developing the capability to deliver major projects. Taking responsibility for the successful delivery of Data Centre EPC projects across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. What We're Looking For: We are looking for a senior Data Centre EPC / Design & Build leader with: 20+ years of relevant engineering, construction or infrastructure experience. Significant experience within Data Centre / Mission Critical environments . Strong hands-on experience across Data Centre EPC, Design & Build or turnkey project delivery . A strong understanding of Data Centre design, engineering, MEP, procurement, construction, integration, testing and commissioning. Proven experience establishing, developing or significantly expanding an EPC capability or business. Experience building and leading multidisciplinary engineering, project and delivery teams. Strong understanding of tendering, costing, technical proposals, project risk and commercial considerations. Established relationships with Data Centre OEMs, consultants, contractors and technology partners. Strong Saudi Arabia / GCC market knowledge and industry relationships. The ability to combine technical EPC expertise with business and organisational leadership . You will have significant autonomy and visibility with senior leadership, with the opportunity to build and lead the Group’s Data Centre EPC capability, develop strategic partnerships and have a direct impact on the Group’s long-term growth strategy. For senior Data Centre EPC professionals interested in exploring the opportunity, please feel free to get in touch for a confidential discussion.

11bb9f7b105dbe65.description: Job description We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Controls Manager to lead and manage project controls functions across major construction and infrastructure projects. The role will be responsible for establishing and maintaining robust project controls systems covering planning, scheduling, cost management, risk, change management, progress measurement, forecasting, and reporting . The successful candidate will work closely with the Project Director, Commercial, Engineering, Construction, and Client teams to provide accurate and timely information to support project decision-making and ensure projects are delivered in accordance with approved time, cost, and performance objectives . Key Responsibilities Lead the overall Project Controls function , integrating planning, cost, risk, change, progress measurement, and reporting activities. Establish and maintain project controls procedures, systems, processes, and reporting standards in accordance with project and client requirements. Develop, review, and maintain integrated master schedules , baseline programmes, recovery programmes, and detailed execution schedules. Monitor project progress against approved baselines and identify schedule slippage, critical path issues, and potential delays . Manage cost control activities, including budgets, commitments, actual costs, forecasts, cash flow, and Estimate at Completion (EAC) . Coordinate with Commercial and Contracts teams on variations, claims, change orders, and their impact on cost and schedule . Develop and maintain project earned value, progress measurement, and performance management systems where applicable. Lead the preparation of weekly, monthly, and executive-level project controls reports and dashboards. Provide management with accurate analysis of schedule performance, cost performance, trends, risks, and forecast outcomes . Establish and maintain project risk registers , facilitating quantitative and qualitative risk assessments and monitoring mitigation actions. Review contractor and consultant schedules, progress reports, cost reports, and performance submissions. Ensure consistency and accuracy of progress reporting across multiple contractors, consultants, and project workstreams. Identify trends and potential issues early and provide recommendations for corrective and preventive actions . Support project leadership in developing recovery strategies for delayed or underperforming packages. Coordinate with project teams to establish appropriate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and performance dashboards. Ensure effective integration between planning, cost, risk, commercial, procurement, engineering, and construction functions. Lead and mentor Project Controls Engineers, Planners, Cost Engineers, and other project controls personnel. Support senior management and the client with strategic project performance analysis and decision-making . Ensure project controls documentation, data, and reporting comply with established governance and quality requirements. Preferred candidate Years of experience 5+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

About the Role Sirar by stc is seeking a Senior Network Security Engineer (L3 Support) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing advanced network security support, managing escalations, and ensuring the stability and availability of systems on a 24/7 basis. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Provide up to Level-3 support for IT network security issues. Handle escalations and offer advisory and support functions to front and back office teams. Address and resolve security-related incidents and issues, including those outside regular working hours. Respond to and resolve escalated issues from L1 support teams in a timely manner. Participate in system updates and upgrades to maintain functionality and security. Analyze incoming requests for potential risks and identified malicious activity to determine weaknesses, exploitation methods, and effects on systems. Conduct regular security reviews and assessments. Support the change management process by documenting and executing system changes, coordinating with appropriate teams to minimize disruption. Facilitate the handover of new systems and services, ensuring smooth transitions and knowledge transfer. Assist in providing knowledge transfer sessions to L1 teams to enhance their ability to handle common issues. Conduct regular PMR health checks to monitor system availability and security status. Collaborate with network engineers, system administrators, and security professionals to resolve complex technical issues. Coordinate and communicate issues requiring escalation to different teams and initiate follow-up procedures. Evaluate fault reports to identify root causes and generate incident reports. Open and manage tickets with vendors, collaborating with their support teams to ensure timely and effective resolution of faults. Maintain detailed records of ticket statuses and vendor communications for troubleshooting and future reference. Document lessons learned from events and exercises, and facilitate the sharing of best practices and recommendations within cyber operations. 11b40c4287ac4b8f.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن مؤسسة نبت للمقاولات عن حاجتها لـ مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ ومراقبة سير العمل لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، وضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع المشاريع أو البرامج الأخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع والخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق عمل المشروع لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وعملية إغلاق المشروع، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه الرئيسية، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والمتابعة وإدارة الموارد. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.
